subject: Yapon tili
book_title: こんにちは、ともだち！ 2–3 yosh

lessons.name: Yuvinamiz
lessons.goal: Bola qo'l va tish yuvish iboralarini tushunadi
lessons.intro: Bip-bip! Ali hovlida o'ynadi. Voy, qo'llari kir! Laylo shirinlik yedi. Endi nima qilamiz? Yuvinamiz!

items.image_prompt: ALI washing his hands with soap bubbles at a small sink, soft 3D cartoon for kids, white background, no text, square
LAYLO brushing her teeth with a big smile, soft 3D cartoon for kids, white background, no text, square

extra.matn: Qani, kuylaymiz! [ja]あらって、あらって、てを あらおう！[/ja] Shir-shir! [ja]ごしごし、ごしごし、はを みがこう！[/ja] Chik-chik! Endi sen ayt: [ja]てを あらって！[/ja]
extra.doska:
🧼 あらって、あらって、てを あらおう！
🪥 ごしごし、ごしごし、はを みがこう！
extra.sodda: Qo'llaringni ishqala va ayt: [ja]あらって！[/ja]
extra.boshqa_usul: Ovqatdan oldin qo'l yuvayotganda onang bilan birga [ja]てを あらって！[/ja] deb kuyla.

tests.q: Ali qo'llari kir. U nima qiladi?
tests.why: Barakalla! Kir qo'lni yuvamiz: [ja]てを あらって！[/ja] Shir-shir!

tests.q: Laylo shirinlik yedi. Endi tishini yuvadi. Nima deymiz?
tests.why: Ofarin! Tishni yuvamiz: [ja]はを みがいて！[/ja] Chik-chik!

lessons.name: Ovqatlanamiz
lessons.goal: Bola たべる va のむ so'zlarini farqlaydi
lessons.intro: Bip-bip! Qo'llar toza! Endi dasturxonga o'tiramiz. Ali non yeydi, Laylo sut ichadi. Mazali!

items.image_prompt: ALI eating soup with a spoon at a little table, soft 3D cartoon for kids, white background, no text, square
LAYLO drinking water from a cup, soft 3D cartoon for kids, white background, no text, square

extra.matn: Men aytaman, sen top! [ja]パン[/ja] — non. [ja]たべて！[/ja] Am-am! [ja]ミルク[/ja] — sut. [ja]のんで！[/ja] G'ult-g'ult! [ja]みず[/ja]-chi? Endi sen ayt: [ja]のんで！[/ja]
extra.doska:
🍞 パン — たべる
🥛 ぎゅうにゅう — のむ
💧 みず — のむ
extra.boshqa_usul: Kechki ovqatda dadang bilan har luqmada [ja]たべる[/ja], har qultumda [ja]のむ[/ja] deb o'yna.

lessons.name: Uxlaymiz
lessons.goal: Bola ねる va ベッド so'zlarini aytadi
lessons.intro: Bip-bip! Kun tugadi, osmonda oy chiqdi. Ali esnayapti. Ayiqcha ham charchadi. Qayerga boramiz?

items.image_prompt: ALI sleeping peacefully, hugging a teddy bear, soft 3D cartoon for kids, white background, no text, square
items.action: Qo'llaringni yonog'ingga qo'y, ko'zingni yum — xrr-xrr!

items.image_prompt: a cozy small bed with a pillow and a blanket, soft 3D cartoon for kids, white background, no text, square

extra.matn: Sekin kuylaymiz. [ja]ベッド、ベッド、ベッド[/ja] — ayiqcha karavotga yotdi. [ja]ねんね、ねんね、ねんね[/ja] — xrr-xrr. [ja]おやすみ！[/ja] Endi sen ayt: [ja]ねんね！[/ja]
extra.doska:
🛏️ ベッド、ベッド、ベッド
😴 ねんね、ねんね、ねんね
🌙 おやすみ！
extra.boshqa_usul: Yotishdan oldin ayiqchani karavotga yotqizib, onang bilan [ja]ねんね、くまちゃん！おやすみ！[/ja] de.

tests.q: Ali charchadi, esnayapti. U nima qiladi?

lessons.name: Sakra va yugur
lessons.intro: Bip-bip! Tong otdi, uyg'on! Kabuning batareykasi to'la. Sen ham tayyormisan? O'rningdan tur!

items.image_prompt: ALI jumping high with both feet off the ground, soft 3D cartoon for kids, white background, no text, square
LAYLO running happily, soft 3D cartoon for kids, white background, no text, square

extra.matn: Quloq sol, bajar! [ja]ジャンプ！[/ja] Hop! [ja]はしれ！[/ja] Tap-tap! [ja]ジャンプ、ジャンプ、ジャンプ！[/ja] Uf, charchadik! [ja]ねんね！[/ja] Xrr... Bip-bip, tur! Endi sen buyur: [ja]ジャンプ！[/ja]
extra.doska:
🦘 ジャンプ！
🏃 はしって！
😴 ねんね！
extra.sodda: Kabu bilan birga sakra: [ja]ジャンプ！[/ja] Hop!
extra.boshqa_usul: Hovlida dadang [ja]ジャンプ！[/ja] yoki [ja]はしれ！[/ja] desin, sen bajar, keyin sen buyur.

tests.q: Ali to'pga qarab tez-tez boryapti. Tap-tap-tap!

lessons.name: Qarsak va raqs
lessons.goal: Bola てを たたく va おどる ni bajaradi
lessons.intro: Bip-bip! Musiqa chalyapti! Laylo qarsak chalyapti, Ali aylanib raqs tushyapti. Sen ham qo'shil!

items.image_prompt: LAYLO clapping her hands, soft 3D cartoon for kids, white background, no text, square
ALI dancing joyfully, soft 3D cartoon for kids, white background, no text, square

extra.matn: Kuylaymiz, o'ynaymiz! [ja]パチ、パチ、パチ！[/ja] Chap-chap! [ja]ジャンプ、ジャンプ、ジャンプ！[/ja] Hop-hop! [ja]おどろう、おどろう、おどろう！[/ja] Barakalla! Endi sen ayt va qil: [ja]パチパチ！[/ja]
extra.doska:
👏 パチ、パチ、パチ！
🦘 ジャンプ、ジャンプ、ジャンプ！
💃 おどろう、おどろう、おどろう！
extra.sodda: Qarsak chal va ayt: [ja]パチパチ！[/ja]
extra.boshqa_usul: Uyda qo'shiq qo'yib, buvijon bilan [ja]パチパチ！[/ja] va [ja]おどって！[/ja] deb o'yna.

tests.why: Barakalla! Chap-chap — [ja]てを たたく[/ja]. Qarsak chalyapti!

tests.q: Ali musiqaga aylanib o'ynayapti. Bu nima?

lessons.name: Xursand va xafa
lessons.goal: Bola うれしい va かなしい ni yuzdan taniydi
lessons.intro: Bip-bip! Qara, Laylo kulyapti. Ali esa yig'layapti — to'pi yo'qoldi. Kel, yuzlarga qaraymiz!

items.image_prompt: LAYLO with a big happy smile, soft 3D cartoon for kids, white background, no text, square
ALI looking sad with a small tear, soft 3D cartoon for kids, white background, no text, square
items.action: Lablaringni pastga qil, xafa bo'lgandek qil.

extra.matn: Kabu yuz ko'rsatadi, sen top! 😊 — [ja]うれしい[/ja]! 😢 — [ja]かなしい[/ja]. Voy, Ali to'pini topdi! Endi u qanday? Endi sen ayt: [ja]うれしい！[/ja]
extra.doska:
😊 うれしい
😢 かなしい
⚽ アリ — うれしい！
extra.boshqa_usul: Ko'zguga qarab onang bilan jilmayib [ja]うれしい[/ja], xafa bo'lib [ja]かなしい[/ja] deb o'yna.

tests.why: Barakalla! Yig'lasak xafamiz — [ja]かなしい[/ja]. Alini quchoqlaymiz!

tests.q: Laylo raqs tushib kulyapti. U qanday?

lessons.name: Iltimos va kechirasan
lessons.intro: Bip-bip! Sehrli so'z esingdami? [ja]ありがとう！[/ja] — rahmat. Bugun yana ikkita sehrli so'z o'rganamiz!

items.image_prompt: LAYLO politely holding out her hands, asking for a cookie, soft 3D cartoon for kids, white background, no text, square
items.action: Ikki qo'lingni oldinga cho'z, chiroyli so'ra.

items.image_prompt: ALI saying sorry to LAYLO after bumping into her, soft 3D cartoon for kids, white background, no text, square
items.action: Qo'lingni ko'ksingga qo'yib, boshingni egib ol.

extra.matn: Laylo so'raydi: [ja]ケーキ、ください！[/ja] Buvijon beradi. Laylo: [ja]ありがとう！[/ja] Ali Layloga urilib ketdi. Ali: [ja]ごめんね！[/ja] Hamma xursand! Endi sen ayt: [ja]おねがい！[/ja]
extra.doska:
🍰 ケーキ、ください！
🙏 ありがとう！
🙇 ごめんね！
extra.sodda: Qo'lingni cho'z va ayt: [ja]おねがい！[/ja]
extra.boshqa_usul: Bugun uyda nimadir so'rasang [ja]ください[/ja], xato qilsang [ja]ごめんね[/ja] deb ayt.

tests.why: Barakalla! So'raganda [ja]おねがい！[/ja] deymiz — iltimos.

tests.q: Ali Layloning qo'g'irchog'ini tushirib yubordi. Nima deydi?
tests.why: Ofarin! Xato qilsak [ja]ごめんね！[/ja] deymiz — kechirasan.
